name: reload-roundtrip
comment: WP-2.G, the reload op (tests/golden/README.md "Reload"). A stone floor; a player (id 0) with 64 cobblestone, 3 diamonds and 10 sticks in hotbar slots 0-2; a pig (id 1); an item entity (5 cobblestone, id 2); a chest at (3,61,-2) filled by slot_click (single chest: 0-26 chest, 27-53 main, 54-62 hotbar): 1 cobblestone into slot 0 with a right click, the other 63 into slot 4, the diamonds shift-clicked into the first empty slot (1), one stick put into slot 13 with a right click and the other 9 put back into hotbar slot 2. At t=19 sand is set in the air at (0,65,-3): its onBlockAdded schedules a tick for world time 22. At t=20 a save (Tier S: the chest's chunk and the player's) and the reload: the old world saved again, dropped, the save opened with the loading constructor, World.rand / field_9437_g / soundCounter carried over, the old world's chunks loaded again in load order (the pig and the item come back from chunk (-1,-1) and (0,0) with new entity ids, the chest from chunk (0,-1)), the player read from level.dat with a new id. The sand's scheduled tick is not saved by b1.7.3, so after the reload the sand stays in the air (scheduled_ticks count 0, the block dump at t=39). 20 more ticks, then the final save. entity_state and rng_state every tick.
